name: AOMEI Backupper
description_en:
AOMEI Backupper is installed Windows software for image backup, recovery, file synchronization and disk migration. The Windows family separates personal PC, business PC, server and technician editions. Backupper Mac and the centralized AOMEI Cyber Backup product have separate scopes.

Choose it around the recovery task: recovering yesterday’s document, rebuilding an unbootable PC and moving an operating system to an SSD require different artifacts and checks. This research explains those boundaries from official pages; no backup or restore was executed.
description_zh:
AOMEI Backupper 是安装在 Windows 上的镜像备份、恢复、文件同步和磁盘迁移软件。Windows 产品系列区分个人电脑、商用电脑、服务器及技术人员版本；Backupper Mac 和集中管理的 AOMEI Cyber Backup 另有范围。

应按恢复任务选择：找回昨天的文档、重建无法启动的电脑、把操作系统迁至 SSD，需要的备份产物和检查不同。本文依据官方页面说明这些边界，未实际执行备份或恢复。

sections.title_en: Images, synchronization and clones solve different tasks
sections.title_zh: 镜像、同步和克隆解决不同任务
sections.en:
A system or disk backup creates an image for later restoration. Synchronization maintains files at another location, while cloning prepares another disk. These operations should not be treated as interchangeable recovery histories. For example, a mirror or two-way sync can propagate deletion; retaining only the synchronized destination may not meet an earlier-version recovery requirement.

The edition comparison explicitly limits Standard disk cloning to data disks. Do not infer free operating-system migration from a generic “disk clone” label. Match the required method and business-use rights to the selected edition.
sections.zh:
系统或磁盘备份生成供日后恢复的镜像；同步维护另一位置的文件；克隆则准备另一块磁盘。三者不能当成相同的历史恢复机制。例如，镜像同步或双向同步可能传播删除，仅保留同步目标未必能满足恢复旧版本的要求。

版本对照明确把 Standard 的磁盘克隆限制为数据盘，不能从“磁盘克隆”标签推断免费迁移操作系统。需将方法和商用权限与所选版本对应。

sections.en:
A full backup establishes the base. Incremental backups record changes relative to the preceding backup, whereas differential backups reference the full backup. The official guide explains that recovery dependencies differ and that a missing or damaged full backup can force creation of another full backup.

For a hypothetical weekly base with daily changes, retain the artifacts needed by the chosen method and recover a sample from a later point. Do not manually delete apparently redundant chain files to reclaim space without understanding the backup scheme. Storage savings alone do not establish recoverability.
sections.zh:
完整备份建立基线；增量记录相对上一次备份的变化，差异记录相对完整备份的变化。官方指南说明两者恢复依赖不同，完整备份丢失或损坏还可能导致重新生成完整备份。

假设每周建立基线、每天记录变化，应保留对应方法所需的产物，并从较晚时间点恢复样例。不了解备份方案前，不要为了腾空间手工删除看似多余的链文件。节省存储本身不能证明可以恢复。

sections.title_en: Prepare for a computer that cannot boot
sections.title_zh: 为无法启动的电脑准备恢复环境
sections.en:
The system restore guide requires an AOMEI system image; Windows restore points and other tools’ images do not substitute. It supports choosing a task or image and selecting the destination. The target partition is overwritten, so an evaluation should use a disposable destination. Universal Restore for different hardware is a paid function.

Create and test WinPE rescue media while the PC works. The boot-media guide discusses driver additions, environment downloads and BIOS/UEFI constraints. Confirm the actual rescue environment can see the backup storage and target disk; a successfully created USB is not proof of a successful recovery.
sections.zh:
系统恢复指南要求 AOMEI 系统镜像，Windows 还原点或其他工具镜像不能替代。可选择任务或镜像并指定目标；目标分区会被覆盖，评估应使用可丢弃目标。不同硬件的 Universal Restore 为付费功能。

应在电脑正常时制作并测试 WinPE 救援介质。介质指南涉及添加驱动、下载环境以及 BIOS/UEFI 限制。需确认实际救援环境看得到备份存储和目标磁盘；USB 制作成功不能证明恢复成功。

sections.title_en: Separate a software license from cloud storage
sections.title_zh: 区分软件许可与云存储
sections.en:
The Pro purchase page lists one-PC personal-use licenses: USD 39.95 yearly with automatic renewal, USD 69.95 lifetime with upgrades, and USD 89.95 family lifetime for five PCs. These are page snapshots, with optional cloud storage shown separately. The page says tax can raise the checkout price.

Standard is freeware, but does not imply every paid feature or business/server entitlement. A lifetime software license should not be read as perpetual included cloud capacity. Confirm the cloud option’s term and selected edition before paying; a normalized monthly amount is left unset.
sections.zh:
Pro 购买页列出个人使用许可：单电脑年付 39.95 美元并自动续费、单电脑终身含升级 69.95 美元、五电脑家庭终身 89.95 美元。这是页面快照，可选云存储另列，页面也说明税费可能提高结账金额。

Standard 是免费软件，但不包含所有付费功能或商用、服务器权益。软件终身许可不能理解为永久附送云容量。付款前应确认云选项期限和版本，本文不填写折算月价。

sections.title_en: Read job results, then prove the required recovery
sections.title_zh: 先读任务结果，再验证所需恢复
sections.en:
View Logs distinguishes successful, failed and cancelled operations and records error codes. For failed scheduled jobs, investigate the actual error and relevant log folder instead of assuming a schedule means fresh protection.

Backupper is a candidate for Windows users who can own the destination storage and recovery media. Centralized heterogeneous infrastructure or application-specific consistency requirements deserve a product-specific check rather than assuming the whole AOMEI family is included. A sample file restore and a spare-disk boot test are useful acceptance criteria, proposed here but not performed.
sections.zh:
View Logs 区分成功、失败和取消，记录错误代码。定时任务失败时应调查具体错误和日志目录，不能把“已设定调度”当作备份持续更新。

能够管理目标存储和救援介质的 Windows 用户可考虑 Backupper。集中管理异构基础设施或应用一致性需求，需要按具体产品确认，不能假定整个 AOMEI 家族都已包含。样例文件恢复和备用盘启动测试可作为验收条件，本文只是提出建议，未实际执行。
